gloss: bento shop; bento restaurant; takeout lunch shop

definitions.explanation: A shop that makes and sells boxed lunches ({弁当|べんとう}) for takeout. Common near train stations, offices, and busy streets in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁当屋|べんとうや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought lunch at the bento shop in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{弁当屋|べんとうや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧おいしい。
examples.english: This bento shop is cheap and tasty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁当屋|べんとうや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: On busy days I get a meal from the neighborhood bento shop.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (boxed lunch) + the suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop). The suffix ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ attaches to many goods to name the shop or seller: ⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧ (bookstore), ⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧ (florist), ⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧ (butcher).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弁当屋|べんとうや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a bento shop
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁当屋|べんとうや}: the bento shop in front of the station
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁当屋|べんとうや}: a handmade-bento shop
